card.text: A star 25 parsecs away that spins so fast its equator is a third wider than its poles.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Megrez"
sources.quote: Megrez, also called Delta Ursae Majoris, is a star in the northern constellation of Ursa Major.

introduction.text: Its equatorial radius is 2.51 solar radii and its polar radius 1.89; the poles are near 9,550 K and the equator near 7,240 K.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Megrez"
sources.quote: With an apparent magnitude of +3.3, it is the dimmest of the seven stars in the Big Dipper asterism.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: Measured color, with hot bright poles and a cool equator from the star's fast spin. The darker edge is a model.
